examples.name: tungsten_density_at_internal_transport_barrier
examples.description:
Particle number density of tungsten ions evaluated on the flux surface
assigned to an internal transport barrier, summed over all tungsten ion
charge states and excluding neutral tungsten.

examples.name: deuterium_tritium_density_at_internal_transport_barrier
examples.description:
Particle number density of the combined deuterium-tritium fuel-ion
pseudo-species evaluated on the flux surface assigned to an internal
transport barrier, where locally reduced cross-field turbulent transport can
sustain steep fuel-density gradients; deuterium and tritium ions are treated
as one effective population.

examples.name: beryllium_density_at_internal_transport_barrier
examples.description:
Particle number density of beryllium ions evaluated on the flux surface
assigned to an internal transport barrier, summed over all beryllium ion
charge states and excluding neutral beryllium.

items.name: ion_energy_diffusion_coefficient
items.description:
Effective coefficient relating an ion population's density-normalized
diffusive energy flux to its temperature gradient, without selecting a
transport direction.

items.name: breakdown_initial_time
items.description:
Timestamp at which plasma breakdown begins and discharge current starts to
flow.

items.name: vertical_non_axisymmetric_magnetic_field
items.description:
Vertical magnetic field on a control surface is the signed axial component
of the external-coil vacuum field remaining after its toroidal mean is
removed.

items.name: derivative_of_volume_of_flux_surface_with_respect_to_poloidal_magnetic_flux_coordinate
items.description:
Geometric rate of change of the cumulative volume enclosed by a nested
magnetic flux surface as its signed poloidal flux coordinate varies.

examples.name: helium_4_density_at_plasma_boundary
examples.description:
Number density of helium-4 ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on
the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all charge states.

examples.name: hydrogen_density_at_plasma_boundary
examples.description:
Number density of hydrogen ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated locally on
the last closed magnetic flux surface and summed over all hydrogen ion
charge states.

examples.name: tritium_density_at_plasma_boundary
examples.description:
Number density of tritium ions at the plasma boundary, evaluated as the
local, intensive particle count per physical volume on the last closed
magnetic flux surface.

items.name: vertical_coordinate_of_annulus_center
items.description:
Vertical coordinate of the annulus center specifies its signed height from
the zero-height plane, parallel to the symmetry axis in the right-handed
cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

examples.name: parallel_conductivity
examples.description:
Local electrical response coefficient relating the electric field along the
magnetic field to the conductive current density it drives in plasma.

examples.name: poloidal_conductivity
examples.description:
Local electrical response coefficient relating a poloidal electric field to
conductive current density along the flux-surface tangent in a
constant-toroidal-angle plane.

examples.name: vertical_conductivity
examples.description:
Local electrical conductivity relating an electric field along the toroidal
symmetry axis to the conductive current density induced in that same
direction.

items.name: thickness_of_plasma_facing_component
items.description:
Through-material geometric separation between a plasma-facing component’s
exposed surface and its opposite material boundary, evaluated at the
component midplane.

items.name: total_neutron_source_rate_due_to_thermal_fusion
items.description:
Total neutron production rate from thermonuclear neutron-producing
deuterium-deuterium, deuterium-tritium, and tritium-tritium reaction
branches among Maxwellian bulk ions, excluding beam-target and beam-beam
fast-ion contributions.

items.name: electrostatic_potential_imaginary_part
items.description:
Electrostatic potential imaginary part is the signed quadrature component
that multiplies the imaginary unit in a complex representation of an
electrostatic potential. It denotes only that imaginary component, not the
full complex potential or its real part.

items.name: lower_bound_energy_of_detector_pixel
items.description:
The lower bound energy of a detector pixel is the minimum photon energy
accepted by that pixel's spectral bandpass in an X-ray crystal spectrometer.

items.name: flux_due_to_surface_emission
items.description:
Flux of any physical quantity emanating from a material surface through
emission processes such as particle recycling, sputtering, or secondary
electron and photon emission.

items.name: voltage_of_mass_spectrometer_channel
items.description:
Signed bias potential applied between the photomultiplier detector electrode
and its electronics reference for one mass-resolved channel, setting
ion-signal gain.

items.name: toroidal_implicit_ion_momentum_source_rate
items.description:
Toroidal implicit ion momentum source rate is the signed coefficient
multiplying one ion species’ toroidal momentum, with negative values
describing proportional damping.

items.name: ion_charge_state_momentum_flux
items.description:
Vector of linear-momentum transport rate per unit area for ions in a
specific charge state, with directional projections characterizing
charge-state-resolved momentum transport across magnetic flux surfaces.

examples.name: radial_wave_electric_field
examples.description:
Complex phasor of the wave electric field projected onto the R direction of
the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, preserving local amplitude,
phase, and radial polarization.

examples.name: toroidal_wave_electric_field
examples.description:
Complex phasor component of an electromagnetic-wave electric field projected
onto the toroidal direction, preserving local amplitude, phase, and toroidal
polarization.

examples.name: parallel_wave_electric_field
examples.description:
Complex phasor of the wave electric field projected along the local
equilibrium magnetic-field direction in a magnetized plasma.

items.name: current_due_to_ion_cyclotron_current_drive
items.description:
Net toroidal plasma current generated non-inductively by ion-cyclotron wave
absorption and integrated over the plasma cross-section.

items.name: alpha_angle_of_plasma_filament
items.description:
Signed inclination of the first side of a plasma-filament oblique
cross-section, measured counterclockwise from the outward radial direction
in the poloidal plane.

items.name: reference_phase
items.description:
Reference phase is the signed angular offset that fixes the phase origin of
a complex oscillatory perturbation relative to a chosen zero-phase
reference.

items.name: toroidal_thermal_ion_charge_state_torque_due_to_collisions
items.description:
Toroidal component of the volume-integrated Coulomb-collisional torque on
thermal ions of a selected charge state, giving the net rate of toroidal
angular momentum transfer to that ion population by collisions.

examples.name: toroidal_perturbed_plasma_magnetic_field_real_part
examples.description:
Toroidal perturbed plasma magnetic-field real part is the in-phase φ
component, in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, of the complex
first-order plasma magnetic-field perturbation eigenfunction for one
specified toroidal Fourier harmonic. In this frame, R is major radius, φ is
toroidal angle, and Z is vertical height.

examples.name: poloidal_perturbed_plasma_magnetic_field_real_part
examples.description:
Real part of the complex poloidal component of the first-order plasma
magnetic-field perturbation eigenfunction for a specified toroidal Fourier
mode in linear MHD stability analysis.

examples.name: radial_perturbed_plasma_magnetic_field_real_part
examples.description:
Radial perturbed plasma magnetic field real part is the in-phase radial
component of the complex first-order plasma magnetic-field perturbation for
one toroidal Fourier harmonic. The radial direction is the R component in
the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

examples.name: accumulated_krypton_count
examples.description:
Cumulative number of krypton atoms injected into the machine since plasma
breakdown, expressed as 36 equivalent electrons for each krypton atom.

examples.name: accumulated_neon_count
examples.description:
Cumulative number of neon atoms from gas injection accumulated since plasma
breakdown, expressed in equivalent electrons; each injected neon atom
contributes ten equivalent electrons.

examples.name: accumulated_argon_count
examples.description:
Accumulated argon count is the cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of
argon atoms delivered by gas injection after plasma breakdown. Each argon
atom contributes 18 equivalent electrons, equal to its atomic number; this
is delivered inventory, not plasma electron content or ionization state.

examples.name: toroidal_ion_momentum_damping_rate
examples.description:
Effective inverse relaxation time for dissipative decay of the toroidal
bulk-flow momentum of a specified ion species, aggregated over its ionic
charge states.

examples.name: radial_ion_momentum_damping_rate
examples.description:
Effective inverse relaxation time for collisional and neoclassical decay of
a specified ion species' ordered momentum along increasing distance from the
toroidal symmetry axis.

examples.name: parallel_ion_momentum_damping_rate
examples.description:
Effective inverse relaxation time for collisional or neoclassical decay of
magnetic-field-aligned bulk-flow momentum in an ion species, including all
its ionic charge states.

items.name: neutron_flux_maximum_at_first_wall
items.description:
Maximum neutron flux at the first wall of a breeding-blanket module is the
largest local neutron energy flux on that module first-wall surface,
identifying the highest local neutron loading relevant to material damage
and blanket lifetime.

items.name: power_of_soft_xray_detector
items.description:
Band-integrated radiant power received by a soft X-ray detector channel over
its selected photon-energy band or bands.

examples.name: vertical_ion_momentum_flux
examples.description:
Vertical ion momentum flux is the transport rate per unit area of the
vertical component of linear momentum for the total ion population through a
surface whose normal is parallel to the Z direction in the right-handed
cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, summed over all ion species and charge states.

examples.name: parallel_ion_momentum_flux
examples.description:
Parallel ion momentum flux is the rate per unit area at which the
magnetic-field-aligned momentum of an ion species crosses an oriented
surface.

examples.name: toroidal_ion_momentum_flux
examples.description:
Toroidal ion momentum flux is the area-averaged transport of toroidal linear
momentum across a magnetic flux surface for one ion species, summed over
ionic charge states.

items.name: current_due_to_fusion_reactions
items.description:
Net parallel plasma current generated by fusion reactions, associated with
fast alpha particles produced by deuterium–tritium reactions and distinct
from other non-inductive current-drive mechanisms.

examples.name: parallel_neutral_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
examples.description:
Dimensionless factor scaling the collisionless free-streaming cap on the
magnetic-field-parallel component of neutral momentum flux in edge-fluid
transport closures.

examples.name: poloidal_neutral_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
examples.description:
Dimensionless coefficient scaling the free-streaming bound on poloidal
neutral momentum flux, limiting its magnitude without reversing its
direction.

examples.name: vertical_neutral_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
examples.description:
Dimensionless vertical momentum flux-limiter coefficient that scales the
free-streaming upper bound on neutral-particle momentum-flux density in
edge-plasma transport closures.

examples.name: vertical_neutral_velocity
examples.description:
Mean directed motion of a selected neutral species along the vertical
symmetry-axis direction, averaged over contributing internal states with
number-density weighting.

examples.name: radial_neutral_velocity
examples.description:
Major-radius component of a neutral species' mean flow in the right-handed
cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame, with number-density-weighted averaging over
contributing internal states.

examples.name: parallel_neutral_velocity
examples.description:
Signed component of a neutral species' mean translational flow along the
local magnetic field, density-weighted over contributing internal states.

items.name: length_of_fiber_optic_current_sensor
items.description:
Total physical arclength of the optical fiber centerline in a fiber-optic
current sensor, defining its optical propagation distance and distributed
magneto-optic interaction length.

items.name: voltage_of_flux_loop
items.description:
Terminal voltage of a flux loop is the signed, unintegrated electrical
potential difference at the loop terminals. It is induced by the time
variation of the oriented magnetic flux linked by the loop and is related to
that flux by Faraday's law.

items.name: greenwald_density
items.description:
Greenwald density is the empirical electron number-density limit associated
with a confined plasma, set by the magnitude of plasma current and the
effective minor radius. It is the density reference used by Greenwald
fractions, not the fraction itself.

examples.name: toroidal_neutral_momentum_flux
examples.description:
Toroidal neutral momentum flux measures signed toroidal linear-momentum
transfer per unit area and time across an oriented surface in the edge
plasma, summed over neutral species and internal states.

examples.name: poloidal_neutral_momentum_flux
examples.description:
Poloidal neutral momentum flux is linear momentum transported per unit area
and time in the local poloidal direction by the represented neutral
population.

examples.name: parallel_neutral_momentum_flux
examples.description:
Parallel neutral momentum flux is the signed rate per area at which
magnetic-field-parallel momentum carried by neutral atoms and molecules
crosses an oriented surface, summed over species and internal states.

items.name: particle_torque_density_due_to_coulomb_collisions_with_electrons
items.description:
Local vector rate of angular-momentum transfer per unit volume delivered to
a specified particle population by Coulomb collisions with electrons.

examples.name: toroidal_lithium_velocity_at_pedestal_top
examples.description:
Toroidal component of the lithium impurity ion fluid velocity evaluated at
the H-mode pedestal top. It represents the local azimuthal rotation of
lithium impurity ions at the steep-gradient edge transport barrier, not a
pedestal-region average.

examples.name: toroidal_xenon_velocity_at_pedestal_top
examples.description:
Density-weighted toroidal bulk-flow velocity of xenon ions, averaged over
all ionization states at the core-side shoulder of the H-mode edge transport
barrier.

examples.name: toroidal_nitrogen_velocity_at_pedestal_top
examples.description:
Density-weighted toroidal flow velocity of ionized nitrogen across its
charge states, evaluated at the core-side shoulder of the H-mode edge
transport barrier.

items.name: neutral_gas_pressure_of_gauge
items.description:
Neutral gas pressure of a gage is the pressure indicated by a barometry gage
for residual neutral gas in the vacuum vessel or surrounding vacuum system.
It represents local vacuum conditions rather than a kinetic neutral-particle
pressure moment.

examples.name: radial_magnetization_of_ferritic_element
examples.description:
Signed radial component of the effective magnetization vector assigned to a
ferritic element in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

examples.name: vertical_magnetization_of_ferritic_element
examples.description:
Signed vertical component of the effective magnetization vector assigned to
a ferritic element in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

examples.name: toroidal_magnetization_of_ferritic_element
examples.description:
Toroidal component of the ferritic-element magnetization vector: the signed
projection of the effective magnetization assigned to a discrete ferritic
element onto the positive toroidal direction in the right-handed cylindrical
(R, φ, Z) frame. This is the element-level convention, not a pointwise
bulk-material magnetization field.

items.name: runaway_electron_kinetic_energy_density
items.description:
Kinetic energy per unit volume carried by the runaway-electron population,
including relativistic motion and excluding rest-mass energy.

items.name: surface_area_of_detector
items.description:
Geometric surface area of the detector face defining the physical extent of
one diagnostic detector.

items.name: y_unit_vector_of_pellet_injector
items.description:
Cartesian y component of the unit vector aligned with the unshattered pellet
velocity direction immediately before shattering.

items.name: current_of_passive_loop
items.description:
Signed conventional electric current circulating in one axisymmetric passive
conducting loop, induced by changing linked magnetic flux and
electromagnetic coupling.

examples.name: radial_ion_momentum_diffusivity
examples.description:
Diffusion coefficient relating the diffusive radial ion momentum flux to the
local radial ion momentum gradient, expressing down-gradient redistribution
within the total ion population summed over charge states.

examples.name: poloidal_ion_momentum_diffusivity
examples.description:
Effective kinematic coefficient governing diffusive redistribution of an ion
species’ poloidal bulk-flow momentum, with all ionic charge states included.

examples.name: parallel_ion_momentum_diffusivity
examples.description:
Effective kinematic coefficient for field-aligned diffusion of an ion
species’ momentum, driven by gradients of its charge-state-averaged parallel
flow velocity.

items.name: non_axisymmetric_magnetic_field
items.description:
Non-axisymmetric magnetic-field vector of the local vacuum induction
generated by external coils, with its toroidally averaged component removed.

items.name: thermal_neutral_density
items.description:
Number density of neutral particles in the thermal population of a specified
atomic or molecular species, including all internal states but excluding
ions and nonthermal neutrals.

items.name: left_hand_circularly_polarized_wave_electric_field_imaginary_part
items.description:
Signed imaginary quadrature of the left-hand circular E-plus wave
electric-field phasor along a beam or ray path, relative to a specified
phase reference.

examples.name: radial_electron_particle_flux
examples.description:
Radial electron particle flux is the signed net electron-number transport
across magnetic flux surfaces per unit area normal to a surface. It includes
diffusive and convective contributions to electron-density transport.

examples.name: poloidal_electron_particle_flux
examples.description:
Poloidal electron particle flux is the signed net electron crossing rate per
unit area perpendicular to the local poloidal direction around a plasma
cross-section.

examples.name: parallel_electron_particle_flux
examples.description:
Parallel electron particle flux is the net electron crossing rate per unit
area perpendicular to the local magnetic field, signed along that field.

examples.name: vertical_current_density_due_to_ion_neutral_friction
examples.description:
Vertical current density due to ion–neutral friction is the signed
electric-charge flux contribution along the symmetry axis arising from
momentum exchange between plasma ions and neutrals.

examples.name: toroidal_current_density_due_to_ion_neutral_friction
examples.description:
Toroidal current density due to ion–neutral friction is the signed
electric-charge flux contribution along the toroidal direction arising from
momentum exchange between ions and neutrals.

examples.name: poloidal_current_density_due_to_ion_neutral_friction
examples.description:
Poloidal current density due to ion–neutral friction is the signed
electric-charge flux contribution along the local poloidal tangent arising
from momentum exchange between ions and neutrals.

examples.name: radial_volumetric_force
examples.description:
Radial component of the electromagnetic body-force density vector, projected
onto the direction of increasing major radius R in the right-handed
cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

examples.name: vertical_volumetric_force
examples.description:
Vertical component of the electromagnetic body-force density vector acting
on plasma volumes or conducting wall and structural elements, projected onto
increasing vertical height Z in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z)
frame.

examples.name: toroidal_volumetric_force
examples.description:
Toroidal component of the electromagnetic body-force density vector acting
on plasma volumes or conducting wall and structural elements, projected onto
increasing toroidal angle φ in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

items.name: thermal_ion_pressure
items.description:
Pressure of thermal ions is the isotropic kinetic stress from random motion,
summed over ionic charge states and excluding fast-ion and bulk-flow
contributions.

items.name: toroidal_width_of_antenna_strap
items.description:
Toroidal width of the antenna strap is its full edge-to-edge physical extent
in the direction around the toroidal symmetry axis.

examples.name: ratio_of_volume_averaged_boron_density_to_volume_averaged_electron_density
examples.description:
Dimensionless global boron abundance ratio using separately volume-averaged
boron and electron number densities, with neutral boron and every ionic
charge state included.

examples.name: ratio_of_volume_averaged_tritium_density_to_volume_averaged_electron_density
examples.description:
Ratio of volume-averaged tritium density to volume-averaged electron density
is the volume-averaged tritium number density, summed over all charge
states, divided by the volume-averaged electron number density.

examples.name: ratio_of_volume_averaged_helium_4_density_to_volume_averaged_electron_density
examples.description:
Helium-4 abundance ratio formed from mean densities inside the last closed
flux surface, comparing the charge-state-summed helium-4 ion density with
the electron density after each density is volume averaged.

examples.name: flux_surface_averaged_helium_3_density_at_plasma_boundary
examples.description:
Number density of helium-3 ions averaged over the plasma boundary, summed
over all helium-3 ion charge states and excluding neutral helium-3.

examples.name: flux_surface_averaged_hydrogen_density_at_plasma_boundary
examples.description:
Number density of hydrogen ions averaged over the plasma-boundary flux
surface, with all hydrogen ion charge states summed and neutral hydrogen
excluded.

examples.name: flux_surface_averaged_argon_density_at_plasma_boundary
examples.description:
Number density of argon ions averaged over the last closed magnetic flux
surface, summed over all argon ion charge states and excluding neutral
argon.

examples.name: carbon_density_at_pedestal_top
examples.description:
Carbon ion number density at the top of the H-mode edge pedestal is the
local concentration of carbon ions, summed over all ionization states and
excluding neutral carbon.

examples.name: tritium_density_at_pedestal_top
examples.description:
Tritium ion number density at the top of the H-mode edge pedestal, summed
over all tritium charge states.

examples.name: lithium_density_at_pedestal_top
examples.description:
Local number density of charged lithium ions at the top of the H-mode edge
pedestal, summed over all lithium ionization states and excluding neutral
lithium.

items.name: field_line_length
items.description:
Arclength of an individually traced magnetic field line during plasma
initiation, resolving the field-line length distribution rather than
reporting an average connection length.

items.name: derivative_of_volume_of_flux_surface_with_respect_to_toroidal_flux_coordinate
items.description:
Geometric rate at which the cumulative volume enclosed by a nested magnetic
flux surface changes with its dimensionful toroidal-flux coordinate.

items.name: neutral_species_atomic_mass
items.description:
Neutral-species atomic mass is the neutral-atom reference mass per atom of a
selected elemental or isotopic constituent, including its bound electrons.

items.name: incident_ion_particle_flux_at_wall
items.description:
Areal arrival rate of particles from a selected ion species at a wall
surface, summed over all ionization states.

items.name: neutral_power_at_divertor_target
items.description:
Net rate of energy deposited on one divertor target by incident neutral
particles, including charge-exchange neutrals and neutral products of volume
recombination.

items.name: parallel_ion_particle_diffusivity
items.description:
Effective Fickian coefficient governing down-gradient ion particle transport
along the local magnetic-field direction in the ion continuity equation.

items.name: voltage_of_valve
items.description:
Voltage applied to a gas-injection valve to drive its opening, serving as
the electrical input to the valve's gas-flow response.

examples.name: poloidal_ion_charge_state_momentum_diffusion_coefficient
examples.description:
Effective kinematic coefficient relating diffusive transport of poloidal
flow momentum to flow shear for ions of one species in a specified charge
state.

examples.name: radial_ion_charge_state_momentum_diffusion_coefficient
examples.description:
Effective kinematic diffusion coefficient for redistribution of the
major-radius component of momentum carried by ions of one specified species
and charge state.

examples.name: parallel_ion_charge_state_momentum_diffusion_coefficient
examples.description:
Kinematic diffusion coefficient governing down-gradient transport along the
magnetic field of flow momentum carried by ions of one species in a
specified charge state.

items.name: density_at_magnetic_axis
items.description:
Local particle concentration of a specified plasma population at the
magnetic axis, with ion charge states aggregated and compound fuel mixtures
treated as defined populations.

items.name: fast_particle_pressure
items.description:
Fast-particle pressure is the isotropic scalar pressure contribution of the
total suprathermal (nonthermal) particle population, combining its
field-parallel and transverse stress contributions.

items.name: ethane_source_rate
items.description:
Instantaneous ethane-gas injection rate into the plasma vessel, expressed as
equivalent electrons per second, with 18 equivalent electrons assigned to
each neutral C2H6 molecule.

items.name: parallel_gyrocenter_momentum_flux_normalized_of_gyrokinetic_eigenmode_due_to_e_cross_b_drift
items.description:
Normalized parallel gyrocenter toroidal angular-momentum flux of a
gyrokinetic eigenmode due to E×B drift is the rotating-frame spectral
contribution from the perturbed electrostatic potential’s E×B drift to the
mode’s parallel gyrocenter momentum transport.

items.name: brightness_of_visible_camera
items.description:
Visible-camera brightness is band-integrated photon radiance along a
specified viewing direction over the wavelengths admitted by a visible
passband. It gives the photon rate per projected collecting area and
accepted solid angle, with the spectral dependence integrated over that
band.

items.name: momentum_source
items.description:
Directed rate of momentum transfer to or from a plasma population,
represented as a source density resolved by species, internal state, or
spatial direction.

items.name: radial_ion_charge_state_diffusion_coefficient
items.description:
Effective Fickian coefficient relating major-radius-directed diffusive
particle flux to the opposing number-density gradient for ions of one
species and charge state.

examples.name: radial_perturbed_vacuum_magnetic_field_imaginary_part
examples.description:
Imaginary part of the complex radial component of the linearized
magnetic-field perturbation eigenfunction in the current-free vacuum region
outside the plasma, for a specified toroidal Fourier mode in linear MHD
stability analysis.

examples.name: poloidal_perturbed_vacuum_magnetic_field_imaginary_part
examples.description:
Imaginary component of the complex poloidal projection, along the
increasing-θ tangent in flux coordinates (ρ, θ, φ), of the first-order
magnetic-field perturbation eigenfunction in the current-free vacuum region
outside the plasma boundary for a specified toroidal Fourier mode.

examples.name: toroidal_perturbed_vacuum_magnetic_field_imaginary_part
examples.description:
Imaginary part of the complex toroidal component of the first-order
magnetic-field perturbation eigenfunction in the current-free vacuum region,
for a specified toroidal mode number in linear MHD stability analysis.

examples.name: parallel_diamagnetic_current_density
examples.description:
Parallel component of the diamagnetic current density, obtained by
projecting the magnetic-field–pressure-gradient drift current onto the local
magnetic-field direction.

examples.name: radial_diamagnetic_current_density
examples.description:
Radial diamagnetic current density is the signed major-radius projection of
pressure-gradient-driven electric current in the edge plasma.

examples.name: vertical_diamagnetic_current_density
examples.description:
Vertical diamagnetic current density is the signed projection of
pressure-gradient-driven electric current per unit area along the toroidal
symmetry axis in edge plasma.

items.name: current_density_due_to_heat_viscosity
items.description:
Vector electric current density arising from heat-viscosity terms in the
collisional plasma fluid closure, where the divergence of the heat-viscosity
stress tensor drives net charge transport in a magnetized plasma.

examples.name: line_averaged_tungsten_density
examples.description:
Line-of-sight average of the number density of positively charged tungsten
ions, summed over all ionization states and excluding neutral tungsten.

examples.name: line_averaged_xenon_density
examples.description:
Number density of xenon ions averaged along a chord through the plasma,
summed over all ionization states from singly ionized through fully stripped
xenon and excluding neutral xenon atoms.

examples.name: line_averaged_helium_3_density
examples.description:
Line-averaged helium-3 density is the chord-length average of local ionized
helium-3 density along a specified viewing path, excluding neutral atoms.

items.name: radial_ion_charge_state_diffusivity
items.description:
Radial ion charge-state diffusivity is the effective Fickian particle
diffusivity for ions in a specified ionization state along the radial
direction.

items.name: radial_coordinate_of_closest_wall_point
items.description:
Major-radius coordinate R of the first-wall point nearest the plasma
boundary, measured from the toroidal symmetry axis in the right-handed
cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

items.name: wave_phase_of_antenna_strap
items.description:
Phase angle of the radio-frequency current phasor carried by one
ion-cyclotron-heating antenna strap, defined relative to a specified RF
phase reference.

examples.name: poloidal_current_density_due_to_parallel_viscosity
examples.description:
Poloidal current density due to parallel viscosity is the signed local
poloidal projection of the electric current contribution associated with
magnetic-field-aligned viscous stress.

examples.name: radial_current_density_due_to_parallel_viscosity
examples.description:
Radial current density due to parallel viscosity is the signed major-radius
projection of the electric current contribution associated with
magnetic-field-aligned viscous stress.

examples.name: vertical_current_density_due_to_perpendicular_viscosity
examples.description:
Vertical current density due to perpendicular viscosity is the signed
symmetry-axis projection of electric current generated by the divergence of
perpendicular viscous stress.

items.name: total_momentum_flux
items.description:
Rate of transport of linear momentum per unit area across an oriented
surface in the plasma, combining convective, isotropic pressure, and viscous
stress contributions from any species or population.

examples.name: parallel_current_density_due_to_anomalous_transport
examples.description:
Parallel current density due to anomalous transport is the signed
conventional-charge flux along the local magnetic field attributed to
turbulent, nonclassical plasma transport.

examples.name: radial_current_density_due_to_anomalous_transport
examples.description:
Radial current density due to anomalous transport is the signed
conventional-charge flux along the major-radius direction attributed to
turbulent, nonclassical plasma transport.

examples.name: vertical_current_density_due_to_anomalous_transport
examples.description:
Vertical current density due to anomalous transport is the signed
conventional-charge flux along the toroidal symmetry axis attributed to
turbulent, nonclassical plasma transport.

examples.name: parallel_total_current_density
examples.description:
Parallel total current density is the flux-surface average of the total
current–magnetic-field dot product divided by the reference vacuum toroidal
field.

examples.name: toroidal_total_current_density
examples.description:
Toroidal total current density is the net conventional charge flux per unit
area around the symmetry axis, formed by algebraically summing all included
current contributions.

examples.name: vertical_total_current_density
examples.description:
Vertical total current density is the net conventional electric-charge flux
per unit area along the toroidal symmetry axis, summed algebraically over
all included contributions.

items.name: runaway_electron_density
items.description:
Number density of runaway electrons, the suprathermal electron population
for which electric-field acceleration can overcome collisional drag.

examples.name: poloidal_neutral_particle_flux
examples.description:
Poloidal neutral particle flux is the net particle crossing rate per unit
area normal to the poloidal direction for one neutral species, summed over
internal states.

examples.name: radial_neutral_particle_flux
examples.description:
Radial neutral particle flux is the signed net number flow per unit area and
time toward increasing major radius for one neutral atomic or molecular
species, summed over its internal states. It is the cylindrical major-radius
component, not the flux-surface-normal component.

examples.name: parallel_neutral_particle_flux
examples.description:
Parallel neutral particle flux is the signed net number flow of one neutral
species along the local magnetic field per unit perpendicular area and time,
summed over internal states.

items.name: total_heating_power_due_to_fusion_reactions
items.description:
Gross thermal power delivered to a fusion power plant’s thermal-to-electric
conversion cycle from fusion reactions, including blanket energy
multiplication.

examples.name: vertical_coordinate_of_toroidal_magnetic_field_probe
examples.description:
Vertical position of the geometric center of a toroidal magnetic-field probe
coil, expressed as the signed Z coordinate in the right-handed cylindrical
(R, φ, Z) frame.

examples.name: radial_coordinate_of_poloidal_magnetic_field_probe
examples.description:
Major-radius coordinate locating the center of a poloidal magnetic-field
probe in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame.

examples.name: vertical_coordinate_of_poloidal_magnetic_field_probe
examples.description:
Vertical position of the geometric center of a poloidal magnetic-field
probe, expressed as its signed Z coordinate in the right-handed cylindrical
(R, φ, Z) frame.

items.name: deuterated_methane_source_rate
items.description:
Instantaneous injection rate of deuterated methane (CD4), counted as
equivalent electrons rather than molecules.

items.name: ion_charge_state_average_charge_number
items.description:
Concentration-weighted mean ionic charge number within a specified
charge-state bundle of one ion species, expressing the bundle's mean
ionization state.

examples.name: parallel_ion_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
examples.description:
Dimensionless factor setting the collisionless free-streaming upper bound on
field-aligned ion momentum flux without reversing the flux direction.

examples.name: radial_ion_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
examples.description:
Dimensionless coefficient scaling the collisionless free-streaming bound on
ion momentum flux along the major-radius direction, limiting flux magnitude
without reversing its direction.

examples.name: poloidal_ion_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
examples.description:
Dimensionless coefficient scaling the free-streaming bound on poloidal ion
momentum flux in edge-plasma transport, limiting its magnitude without
reversing its direction.

examples.name: parallel_neutral_state_velocity_due_to_diamagnetic_drift
examples.description:
Field-aligned velocity attributed to an effective diamagnetic
pressure-gradient contribution for one internal state of a neutral species
in the edge plasma.

examples.name: radial_neutral_state_velocity_due_to_diamagnetic_drift
examples.description:
Signed major-radius component of the effective pressure-gradient transport
velocity assigned to one neutral species in a specified internal state,
distinct from direct magnetic drift of neutral particles.

examples.name: toroidal_neutral_state_velocity_due_to_diamagnetic_drift
examples.description:
Particle-flow velocity component assigned to a neutral species state and
projected in the toroidal direction in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ,
Z) frame, attributed to effective diamagnetic pressure-gradient transport.

items.name: ratio_of_particle_temperature_to_particle_reference_temperature
items.description:
Dimensionless ratio comparing a particle species’ kinetic temperature with
the positive reference temperature on the same magnetic flux surface.

examples.name: radial_ion_charge_state_velocity_due_to_e_cross_b_drift
examples.description:
Signed major-radius component of the E×B guiding-center drift for one ion
charge state in the edge plasma, positive away from the toroidal symmetry
axis.

examples.name: toroidal_ion_charge_state_velocity_due_to_e_cross_b_drift
examples.description:
Signed toroidal projection of the mass- and charge-independent E×B
guiding-center drift of one ion charge state in the edge plasma.

examples.name: poloidal_ion_charge_state_velocity_due_to_e_cross_b_drift
examples.description:
Signed poloidal projection of the E×B guiding-center drift for one ion
charge state in the edge plasma, along a specified local poloidal direction.

items.name: parallel_neutral_species_particle_diffusivity
items.description:
Effective particle diffusivity for an ion species along the magnetic field,
relating its diffusive particle flux to its parallel number-density
gradient.

items.name: thermal_particle_power_density_due_to_thermalization
items.description:
Local volumetric heating rate delivered to thermal particles when fast or
suprathermal particles lose kinetic energy through Coulomb thermalization.

examples.name: accumulated_lithium_prefill_count_due_to_gas_injection
examples.description:
Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of lithium introduced by gas
injection during plasma prefill, assigning three count units to each lithium
atom.

examples.name: accumulated_helium_3_prefill_count_due_to_gas_injection
examples.description:
Cumulative equivalent-electron inventory of helium-3 atoms introduced by gas
injection during plasma prefill before plasma breakdown, with two count
units assigned per atom.

examples.name: accumulated_oxygen_prefill_count_due_to_gas_injection
examples.description:
Cumulative oxygen gas introduced during the prefill phase by gas injection,
expressed as an equivalent-electron count where each oxygen atom contributes
8 count units equal to its atomic number.

items.name: fast_ion_charge_state_torque_density_due_to_collisions
items.description:
Collisional torque density is the local angular-momentum transfer rate per
plasma volume delivered to a specified fast ion charge state through Coulomb
collisions.

items.name: nuclear_heating_power_of_divertor
items.description:
Nuclear energy deposition rate integrated throughout the material volume of
one divertor structure, including neutron and other nuclear heating sources.

examples.name: poloidal_current_density_due_to_heat_viscosity
examples.description:
Poloidal current density due to heat viscosity is the signed local charge
flux in the poloidal direction generated by heat-viscosity stresses in a
collisional magnetized plasma.

examples.name: toroidal_current_density_due_to_heat_viscosity
examples.description:
Toroidal current density due to heat viscosity is the signed charge flux
around the symmetry axis generated by heat-viscosity stresses in a
collisional magnetized plasma.

examples.name: parallel_current_density_due_to_heat_viscosity
examples.description:
Parallel current density due to heat viscosity is the signed charge flux
along the local magnetic field generated by heat-viscosity stresses in a
collisional magnetized plasma.

items.name: inner_radius_of_antenna_strap
items.description:
Inner radius of an antenna strap is the perpendicular distance from the
strap conductor axis to the inner cylindrical boundary of its annular
cross-section.

items.name: height_of_correction_coil
items.description:
Full non-negative extent of a rectangular correction-coil conductor
cross-section measured along the local Frenet–Serret binormal.

items.name: safety_factor
items.description:
Safety factor is the signed number of toroidal turns made by a magnetic
field line per complete poloidal circuit on a toroidal magnetic flux
surface.

items.name: ion_charge_state_particle_convection_velocity
items.description:
Effective velocity multiplying the density of a specified ion charge state
in its convective cross-field particle transport.

items.name: flux_at_wall_due_to_recombination
items.description:
Flux at a plasma-facing wall due to recombination is the wall-area density
of a recombination-caused transfer rate at the wall. It fixes the wall locus
and recombination cause; a more specific quantity specifies what is
transported, such as energy, and how incident populations, charge states,
channels, and products are aggregated.

examples.name: toroidal_ion_charge_state_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
examples.description:
Dimensionless toroidal ion charge-state momentum flux-limiter coefficient
that scales the free-streaming bound on toroidal momentum transport for a
specified ion charge state.

examples.name: vertical_ion_charge_state_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
examples.description:
Dimensionless vertical ion charge-state momentum flux-limiter coefficient
that scales the free-streaming bound on vertical momentum transport for a
specified ion charge state.

examples.name: poloidal_ion_charge_state_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
examples.description:
Dimensionless poloidal ion charge-state momentum flux-limiter coefficient
that scales the free-streaming bound on poloidal momentum transport for a
specified ion charge state.

examples.name: radial_neutral_state_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
examples.description:
Coefficient scaling the free-streaming cap on the flux of cylindrical radial
momentum carried by one neutral species in a specified internal state in
edge-plasma transport.

examples.name: parallel_neutral_state_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
examples.description:
Dimensionless parallel flux-limiter coefficient that scales the
free-streaming bound on the parallel momentum-flux-density magnitude,
projected along the local magnetic-field unit vector, for a specified
neutral particle state in edge-plasma transport closures.

examples.name: vertical_neutral_state_momentum_flux_limiter_coefficient
examples.description:
Dimensionless flux-limiter coefficient that scales the free-streaming bound
on the vertical (Z) momentum-flux-density component in the right-handed
cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame for a specified neutral particle state in
edge-plasma transport closures.

examples.name: toroidal_argon_velocity_at_magnetic_axis
examples.description:
Density-weighted toroidal bulk-flow velocity of argon ions at the magnetic
axis, combining all ionization states in the right-handed cylindrical (R, φ,
Z) frame.

examples.name: toroidal_helium_4_velocity_at_magnetic_axis
examples.description:
Toroidal helium-4 velocity at the magnetic axis is the signed bulk-flow
velocity of helium-4 ions projected onto the toroidal φ direction of the
right-handed cylindrical (R, φ, Z) frame at the magnetic axis.

examples.name: toroidal_tritium_velocity_at_magnetic_axis
examples.description:
Signed toroidal fluid velocity of the tritium-ion population evaluated at
the magnetic axis and resolved in the direction of increasing toroidal
angle.

items.name: total_absorbed_wave_power
items.description:
Total coherent electromagnetic-wave power transferred directly to all plasma
particle populations and integrated over all spatial locations.

items.name: thermal_electron_pressure_at_post_sawtooth_crash
items.description:
Pressure of thermal electrons at the post-sawtooth-crash locus is the
isotropic stress from random electron motion in the plasma edge and
scrape-off layer.

items.name: electron_temperature_at_pellet_path
items.description:
Background-plasma electron temperature evaluated locally along the pellet’s
ablation trajectory, describing the thermal state encountered by the pellet
during transit.

items.name: parallel_neutral_internal_state_energy_flux
items.description:
Field-parallel neutral energy flux is the signed thermal-energy transport
per unit area and time along the local magnetic field by one neutral species
in one specified internal state.

examples.name: radial_ion_charge_state_energy_diffusion_coefficient
examples.description:
Fick's-law proportionality coefficient relating the density-normalized
radial diffusive thermal energy flux of a specified ion charge state to its
local temperature gradient.

examples.name: poloidal_ion_charge_state_energy_diffusion_coefficient
examples.description:
Fick's-law proportionality coefficient relating the density-normalized
poloidal diffusive thermal-energy flux of one ion charge state to its local
temperature gradient.

examples.name: parallel_ion_charge_state_energy_diffusion_coefficient
examples.description:
Fick's-law proportionality coefficient relating the density-normalized
parallel diffusive thermal energy flux of a specified ion charge state to
its local temperature gradient.

examples.name: toroidal_center_of_mass_velocity
examples.description:
Signed flow around the symmetry axis, equal to the mass-density-weighted
mean of the toroidal velocities of all constituent plasma species.

examples.name: parallel_center_of_mass_velocity
examples.description:
Signed plasma flow along the local magnetic field, equal to the
mass-density-weighted mean of the field-parallel velocities of all
constituent species.

examples.name: radial_center_of_mass_velocity
examples.description:
Signed major-radius component of plasma flow, equal to the
mass-density-weighted mean of that component over all constituent species.

items.name: momentum_flux_due_to_perturbed_parallel_vector_potential
items.description:
Momentum flux due to a perturbed parallel vector potential is the
dimensionless signed contribution to plasma momentum transport produced by
turbulent fluctuations of the electromagnetic vector potential component
parallel to the magnetic field. It is expressed relative to a positive
reference momentum-flux scale.

items.name: parallel_electric_field_at_separatrix
items.description:
Parallel electric field at the separatrix is the electric field projected
along the local magnetic field on the separatrix. It fixes the field-aligned
projection and separatrix locus, while more specific names may add an
aggregation over that locus.

examples.name: beryllium_density
examples.description:
Local number density of beryllium impurity ions per unit plasma volume,
summed over all ionization states from singly ionized to fully stripped
(Be1+ through Be4+), excluding neutral beryllium atoms.

examples.name: tritium_density
examples.description:
Local number density of tritium ions in the plasma, the foundational
fuel-ion parameter underlying chord-averaged, volume-averaged, and isotopic
ratio child quantities.

examples.name: deuterium_density
examples.description:
Deuterium density is the number density of ionized deuterium in the fuel-ion
population. It is the local density of deuterons, excluding neutral atoms,
molecules, and line- or volume-averaged deuterium densities.
